subject: Graduate Civil Engineer Rail and Metro, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer, Rail and Metro role in Melbourne on the SMEC Workday board (JR118137).

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design covering road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, licence and transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have no rail or metro project experience yet; roads and drainage coursework and site coordination are what I bring into the graduate program.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Graduate Civil Engineer, Rail and Metro
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer, Rail and Metro role in Melbourne (Workday JR118137). The two-year Graduate Development Program with mentoring on design documentation, calculations and site exposure is the structured consulting start I want after finishing my Australian Advanced Diploma in February 2026.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines. I will attach my academic transcript with the online application.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and as field engineer on subdivision finishing works, with crew coordination, inspections, materials tracking and progress reports.

I have no rail or metro project experience and no Australian consulting experience yet. Roads, drainage and documentation under guidance are the parts of the role I am ready to learn on. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would be glad to talk about the Rail and Metro graduate intake.

checklist: Open Workday JR118137 and Apply with CV, cover letter and academic transcript.
Answer honestly that rail and metro experience is new.
Do not email SMEC staff directly; advert says recruitment goes through Resourcing.
Submit while the posting is open.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and Company website.
notes: Victoria offsite SMEC GDP Rail and Metro. Portal only. Rail gap disclosed.
